observation.visible_scene: A dark, heavily grainy low-light (night-vision-like) view centered on a rectangular opening framed by a diffuse arched glow. Inside the rectangle is a textured surface lit by wavy, shifting bright bands (a strong highlight near the center-right). Dark silhouetted foliage-like shapes border the left and right edges of the frame.
visible_changes: The rectangular aperture and the arched glow around it hold essentially the same screen position from the first to the last frame, so the structure itself does not translate across the view.

Within the aperture the wavy bright bands and the central highlight subtly change shape and shift up/down over time, a continuously varying illumination/reflection pattern rather than a moving object.
Strong temporal grain/noise flicker is present across the entire image on every frame.
The dark edge silhouettes remain roughly fixed with only minor apparent jitter; no clear camera pan, tilt, or zoom is supported by the background.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause or nature of the shimmering light pattern (e.g., moving water, fabric, or external light source) is not determined.
What the illuminated structure actually is, and whether the light pattern's fluctuation continues or stops beyond this excerpt, are unseen.
uncertain_details: Whether the slight edge/background jitter is true camera motion or sensor noise cannot be resolved from the available frames.
The material of the surface showing the wavy highlights is indeterminate due to the low-light grain.
